CommunityApplications.Profile: Claude Code for Unraid: an Unraid plugin that installs Anthropic's Claude Code command-line agent natively on the host, keeps its login and conversations across reboots, supervises sessions around array stops and starts, and enforces a safety policy around an agent that runs as root. One plugin, MIT licensed, maintained on GitHub. Community project, not affiliated with Anthropic or Lime Technology. Support: GitHub issues (web page below) and the forum support thread.
